theme_central: Intimate comfort to the Prophet after a pause in revelation: your Lord has neither forsaken you nor been displeased — and remember what He has already done for you.
sources_note: Content widely taught and undisputed; twin surah of Ash-Sharh.

branches.title: Oath, comfort
branches.resume: Oath by the rising morning and the night; your Lord has neither forsaken you nor been displeased.

children.t: Oath, comfort: Allah has neither forsaken nor been displeased with the Prophet

branches.title: Past blessings recalled
branches.resume: The hereafter better than present life; orphan sheltered, one astray guided, poor one enriched.

children.t: Past blessings recalled: orphan sheltered, one astray guided, poor one enriched

branches.title: Ethical implications
branches.resume: Not to oppress the orphan, not to repel the beggar, to proclaim the blessing of one's Lord.

children.t: Not oppressing the orphan, not repelling the beggar, proclaiming the blessing received
